# nomatron_nomad_cluster (Data Source)

Fetch a single global Nomatron Nomad cluster by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_nomad_cluster" "example" {
  name = "prod-global"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact global cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Nomad API address for `direct` connectivity mode.
- `agent_id` (String) Agent ID for `agent` connectivity mode.
- `connectivity_mode` (String) Connectivity mode, either `direct` or `agent`.
- `description` (String) Cluster description.
- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `scope` (String) Cluster scope, typically `global` for this data source.
- `skip_verify` (Boolean) Whether TLS verification is skipped for direct connections.
